response.justification: Broad, deep engineering experience (15+ years) with genuine high-throughput distributed systems exposure at Sociomantic/dunnhumby and current hands-on work on AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling at a Staff level — both strongly aligned with this role. However, the resume shows no Python anywhere in the skills list or job history, which is a stated must-have ('Strong Python'), and the profile skews full-stack/web product and craftsmanship rather than large-scale distributed systems ownership, technical strategy, or cross-functional stakeholder leadership. On-call, incident response, and agile/scrum leadership are only implied, never evidenced. Worth a screening call to probe Python depth, scale of systems owned, and strategy-level influence.
strengths: Current Staff-level role building AI-agent/MCP infrastructure — AI-native baseline is already met
Real high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems work (millions of HTTP req/s, async I/O, caching)
Very strong TypeScript/Node.js plus polyglot breadth, TDD/CI/CD craftsmanship, and founder-level ownership
concerns: No evidence of Python anywhere, despite it being a core must-have
Limited demonstrated technical strategy, stakeholder management, or cross-functional leadership at scale
Operational readiness (on-call, monitoring, incident response) and agile ceremony ownership not explicitly shown
